text: model fitted model. classification forest ranger, fit probability = TRUE. data data predict , usually data model fitted . var Name predictor, string. values Values predictor set, seq(18, 80, = 2). factor, levels factor. class models predict probability class: class whose probability average, "deleted". ... Passed predict(). logistic regression glm(), use type = "response" average probabilities instead log-odds.

title: Partial dependence of a model on one predictor — partial_dependence
code: library(simling) m <- lm(rt ~ log_freq * length, data = megastudy) partial_dependence(m, megastudy, "length", 3:12) #> # A tibble: 10 × 2 #>    value prediction #>    <int>      <dbl> #>  1     3       724. #>  2     4       736. #>  3     5       749. #>  4     6       762. #>  5     7       775. #>  6     8       787. #>  7     9       800. #>  8    10       813. #>  9    11       826. #> 10    12       838.  if (requireNamespace("ranger", quietly = TRUE)) {   rf <- ranger::ranger(deleted ~ following + morph + rate + age, data = td_deletion,                        num.trees = 200, probability = TRUE, seed = 1)   partial_dependence(rf, td_deletion, "age", seq(20, 80, by = 10), class = "deleted") } #> # A tibble: 7 × 2 #>   value prediction #>   <dbl>      <dbl> #> 1    20      0.671 #> 2    30      0.644 #> 3    40      0.680 #> 4    50      0.600 #> 5    60      0.514 #> 6    70      0.497 #> 7    80      0.410  # a logistic regression: average the probabilities, not the log-odds m <- glm(deleted ~ age + rate, data = td_deletion, family = binomial) partial_dependence(m, td_deletion, "age", c(20, 50, 80), type = "response") #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   value prediction #>   <dbl>      <dbl> #> 1    20      0.749 #> 2    50      0.579 #> 3    80      0.389

what: Autocorrelation of residuals within groups — resid_acf
title: Autocorrelation of residuals within groups — resid_acf
text: Computes autocorrelation model residuals within trajectory, time series group, lags 0 max_lag. lag 1 correlation residual residual one measurement earlier group; lag 2 skips one measurement, . Residuals never paired across groups. Used Advanced Statistics check GAMMs autocorrelated residuals; itsadug::acf_resid() base R graphics.

title: Autocorrelation of residuals within groups — resid_acf
text: tibble one row per lag columns lag acf. autocorrelation lag 0 always 1. NA lags long groups, pairs residuals left.

title: Autocorrelation of residuals within groups — resid_acf

title: konstats 0.1.0
text: konstats can installed R-universe (https://mcanzi.r-universe.dev). First version. Installing konstats installs packages Statistics course; install_course("advanced") installs extra packages Advanced Statistics, course_packages() lists . check_setup() checks version R, packages course simling data sets slides use. follow, data sets use slides; slides() opens slides lecture. tutorials() lists exercise sheets get_tutorial() copies project folder, one time get_tutorial("", dir). Sheets Statistics tutorials 1 12 (tutorial 1 guided, code), tutorials practical lectures Advanced Statistics (4, 6, 9 11). R Markdown template weekly assignments. helpers Advanced Statistics slides: resid_acf() (residual autocorrelation within trajectories), partial_dependence() (called partial() slides), cv_speakers() (cross-validation random forest speaker, folds slides) theme_paper().
